result:
I’d break the link between vulnerability and powerlessness.

Being hungry, sick, poor, young, or simply unlucky shouldn’t mean someone else gets to decide what you must endure. You should be able to need help without surrendering your dignity—or your right to say no.

Not a world without difficulty. A world where difficulty doesn’t so easily become a trap.
